articles.title: 3 Things You Should Always Plug Into Your TV's HDMI ARC Port
articles.description: HDMI eARC offers more bandwidth for premium audio formats like Dolby Atmos. Learn which devices belong on that port and what cables to use.

articles.title: New Technique Cuts Quantum Simulation Time By Exploiting Data Patterns
articles.description: Researchers have developed a new technique, Compressed Shadow Tomography, which significantly reduces the number of measurements needed to characterise quantum systems by combining randomised data collection with efficient data compression, achieving potential savings scaling with the number of time steps analysed.

articles.title: AI Model Gains Agency Over Its Own Memory, Managing Context Like A Human
articles.description: Researchers have developed StateLM, a new artificial intelligence model capable of actively managing its own memory using internal tools for context pruning, indexing and note-taking, resulting in significant performance improvements, up to 52% accuracy, on complex tasks requiring long-term reasoning and information recall.

articles.title: 70mai launches new 4K A810S dash cam with built-in GPS and ADAS
articles.description: 70mai has unveiled the new 4K A810S two-channel dash cam in the global market with its in-house Night Owl Vision technology. The dash cam features 4K recording, a 3-inch IPS display, AI motion detection, a built-in GPS and ADAS, and WiFi 6 connectivity for high-speed transfers.

articles.title: MSI’s $5,090 RTX 5090 Lightning Z cracks from thermal shock during 2,500W BIOS test
articles.description: MSI’s $5,090 RTX 5090 Lightning Z was built for extreme overclocking — and it delivered, breaking a Geekbench 5 world record at over 1,000W and 3.5 GHz under liquid nitrogen. But an aggressive 2,500W XOC BIOS and a sudden thermal imbalance ultimately cracked one GPU core, turning a record attempt into a costly casualty.

articles.title: Learning Halts After Three Successes, Certifying Accuracy Through Measurement Runs
articles.description: Researchers have demonstrated that, in quantum machine learning with limited feedback, the reliability of verifying a successful outcome can become a greater obstacle than the amount of data required, particularly when even minor errors in labelling occur.

articles.title: Focused Ion Beam Technique Steers Spin Waves Via Lattice Distortions
articles.description: Researchers have demonstrated that focused ion beam irradiation steers spin waves in yttrium iron garnet by creating lattice dislocations and associated magnetoelastic effects, enabling precise control over their propagation and paving the way for advanced wave-based computing.

articles.title: Parallel Processing Speeds Up Complex Calculations With Relaxed Data Consistency
articles.description: Researchers have demonstrated that the least fixed points of multiple functions can be computed accurately and efficiently using parallel processing with simple overwriting techniques, even with limited synchronisation and without relying on complex merging or contraction methods.

articles.title: Subtle Disorder Within Layered Materials Alters Electrical Flow Between Atomic Planes
articles.description: Researchers have discovered that even minor disruptions between the layers in cuprate materials significantly influence their electrical behaviour, potentially offering a method to enhance superconductivity by managing this interlayer disorder.

articles.title: Robot Planner Tackles Complex Household Tasks With Ambiguous Instructions
articles.description: Researchers have developed Any House Any Task (AHAT), a new robotic planning system employing a language model and reinforcement learning to interpret ambiguous human instructions and generate complex, long-term action plans for household environments, demonstrably outperforming existing methods in scalability and task completion.
